001package com.fs.starfarer.api.combat;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignUIAPI.CoreUITradeMode;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CargoStackAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI.HullSize;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.fleet.FleetMemberAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.loading.HullModSpecAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
012
013/**
014 * Note: the effect class is instantiated once per application session.
015 * Storing campaign data in data members of an implementing class is a bad idea (will likely cause memory leaks),
016 * use SectorAPI.getPersistentData() instead.
017 * @author Alex Mosolov
018 *
019 * Copyright 2015 Fractal Softworks, LLC
020 */
021public interface HullModEffect {
022        void init(HullModSpecAPI spec);
023        void applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation(HullSize hullSize, MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id);
024        
025        /**
026         * Effects applied here should NOT affect ship stats as this does not get called from the campaign.
027         * Apply stat changes in applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation() instead, as that does affect the campaign.
028         * @param ship
029         * @param id
030         */
031        void applyEffectsAfterShipCreation(ShipAPI ship, String id);
032        default void applyEffectsAfterShipCreation2ndPass(ShipAPI ship, String id) {};
033        String getDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize);
034        String getDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship);
035
036        void applyEffectsToFighterSpawnedByShip(ShipAPI fighter, ShipAPI ship, String id);
037        
038        boolean isApplicableToShip(ShipAPI ship);
039        
040        String getUnapplicableReason(ShipAPI ship);
041        
042        /**
043         * Ship may be null from autofit.
044         * @param ship
045         * @param marketOrNull
046         * @param mode
047         * @return
048         */
049        boolean canBeAddedOrRemovedNow(ShipAPI ship, MarketAPI marketOrNull, CoreUITradeMode mode);
050        String getCanNotBeInstalledNowReason(ShipAPI ship, MarketAPI marketOrNull, CoreUITradeMode mode);
051        
052        
053        /**
054         * Not called while paused.
055         * But, called when the fleet data needs to be re-synced,
056         * with amount=0 (such as if, say, a fleet member is moved around.
057         * in the fleet screen.)
058         * @param member
059         * @param amount
060         */
061        void advanceInCampaign(FleetMemberAPI member, float amount);
062        
063        /**
064         * Not called while paused.
065         * @param ship
066         * @param amount
067         */
068        void advanceInCombat(ShipAPI ship, float amount);
069        
070        /**
071         * Hullmods that return true here should only ever be built-in, as cost changes aren't handled when
072         * these mods can be added or removed to/from the variant.
073         * @return
074         */
075        boolean affectsOPCosts();
076        
077        
078        /**
079         * ship may be null, will be for modspecs. hullsize will always be CAPITAL_SHIP for modspecs.
080         * @param hullSize
081         * @param ship
082         * @param isForModSpec
083         * @return
084         */
085        boolean shouldAddDescriptionToTooltip(HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship, boolean isForModSpec);
086        
087        /**
088         * ship may be null, will be for modspecs. hullsize will always be CAPITAL_SHIP for modspecs.
089         * @param tooltip
090         * @param hullSize
091         * @param ship
092         * @param width
093         * @param isForModSpec
094         */
095        void addPostDescriptionSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship, float width, boolean isForModSpec);
096        
097
098        Color getBorderColor();
099        Color getNameColor();
100        
101        /**
102         * Sort order within the mod's display category. Not used when category == 4, since then
103         * the order is determined by the order in which the player added the hullmods.
104         * @return
105         */
106        int getDisplaySortOrder();
107        /**
108         * Should return 0 to 4; -1 for "use default".
109         * The default categories are:
110         *      0: built-in mods in the base hull
111         *      1: perma-mods that are not story point mods
112         *      2: d-mods
113         *      3: mods built in via story points
114         *      4: regular mods
115         * 
116         * @return
117         */
118        int getDisplayCategoryIndex();
119        
120        boolean hasSModEffectSection(HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship, boolean isForModSpec);
121        void addSModSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship, float width, boolean isForModSpec, boolean isForBuildInList);
122        void addSModEffectSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship, float width,
123                        boolean isForModSpec, boolean isForBuildInList);
124        boolean hasSModEffect();
125        
126        
127        void addRequiredItemSection(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, 
128                        FleetMemberAPI member, ShipVariantAPI currentVariant, MarketAPI dockedAt,
129                        float width, boolean isForModSpec);
130        
131        String getSModDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize);
132        String getSModDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize, ShipAPI ship);
133        
134        float getTooltipWidth();
135        boolean isSModEffectAPenalty();
136        
137        boolean showInRefitScreenModPickerFor(ShipAPI ship);
138
139        
140        default CargoStackAPI getRequiredItem() {
141                return null;
142        }
143        
144        /**
145         * Only called once. Not called again if the ship is removed and then added back to the engine.
146         */
147        default void applyEffectsAfterShipAddedToCombatEngine(ShipAPI ship, String id) {
148        }
149}
